signin.title: Sign in to Vanna
signin.lede: Pick a workspace and identify yourself. Each workspace has its own database, its own members, and its own curated knowledge.
account.title: Account
account.passwordHelp: Your current password is required — being signed in is not enough to replace it, so a borrowed laptop cannot lock you out of your own account.
account.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions are unaffected.
account.tokensHelp: For the CLI, vanna mcp, and scripts — anything that cannot hold a browser cookie. A token acts as you, so give each one its own name and revoke the ones you stop using.
account.tokenName: What is it for? e.g. laptop-cli
account.tokenOnce: Copy it now. Only its hash is stored, so it cannot be shown again — if you lose it, revoke it and make another.
account.tokenNeedsName: Give the token a name so you can tell them apart later
account.sessionsHelp: Every browser holding a live session for this account.
account.signOutOthersConfirm: Sign out of every other browser? This one stays signed in.
account.ownKeyHelp: Optional. With a key here, your questions are answered on your account and do not count against the workspace's daily limit — useful once you have hit it. Everything else is unchanged: your questions still appear in History and are still visible to workspace admins.
account.ownKeyBlocked: An administrator has turned this off for this workspace, so questions are answered on the server's key and count towards the workspace limit.
account.keySaved: Saved in this browser. Your questions no longer count against the workspace limit.
account.keyRemoved: Key removed. Back to the workspace limit.
account.keyNeeded: Paste a key, or use Remove to stop using one
account.keyWarning: Stored in this browser only — never sent to our database, and never written to a log. It will not follow you to another device, and any script running on this page could read it. If that is not acceptable for your key, do not put it here.
plan.limitIs: The daily limit is {source}, and is counted across everyone in this workspace over the last 24 hours — not per person.
plan.source.default: the deployment default, as this workspace has no plan
plan.expiredNote: This workspace's subscription has ended, so it has fallen back to the free limits. Nothing has been lost — your data and saved queries are untouched.
plan.adminChange: Change the plan from the admin console.
plan.askAdmin: Ask an admin of this workspace if you need a higher limit.
account.revokeConfirm: Revoke “{name}”? Anything using it stops working immediately.
schema.title: Schema
schema.subPhysical: This is exactly what the model is shown — if a table is missing here, it cannot be queried.
schema.subSemantic: This is the semantic layer — business names, computed columns and declared joins. It is exactly what the model is shown.
history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Ask a question and it will show up.
saved.title: Saved queries
saved.empty: Nothing saved yet. Save a query from History, or add one here.
saved.needTitleAndSql: A title and SQL are required
preview.title: Assembled context
cubes.title: Metrics
dash.title: Dashboards
dash.empty: No dashboards yet. Ask in chat: “build me a dashboard of revenue by region”.
result.noSql: There is no SQL on this entry
ws.title: Workspace
ws.only: This is the only workspace you belong to.
thread.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation and its messages?
cubes.emptyBefore: No metrics defined. Add a cube under
dash.sub: Tiles are executed with your permissions when you open one — two people can open the same dashboard and see different numbers.
saved.sub: Shared with everyone in this workspace. Run them as they are, or use one as the starting point for a new question.
cubes.sub: Pick what to measure and how to break it down. The aggregation is defined once, in the project, so these totals cannot be computed at the wrong grain.
